sections.title: 1. General refund principles
paragraphs: Refund requests for online appointment bookings or advance payments are evaluated based on cancellation timing, service delivery status, and transaction validation.
Approved refunds are credited strictly back to the original source of payment (bank account, UPI handle, credit/debit card, or wallet) within standard institutional banking timeframes.

sections.title: 2. Eligible scenarios for refunds
items: Duplicate or accidental debit transactions processed for a single appointment booking
Advance payments made for services that could not be rendered due to sudden clinic scheduling adjustments
Cancellations requested in accordance with our advance notice guidelines

sections.title: 3. Non-refundable scenarios
items: Consultations, diagnostics, imaging, or dental procedures that have already been fully or partially delivered
Specialized administrative or diagnostic lab fees consumed during patient physical examination
No-show appointments where the dental team was kept waiting without prior cancellation notice

sections.title: 4. Processing timeline
paragraphs: Once an online refund is officially approved by Creadent Dental Clinic, it typically takes 5 to 7 business days to reflect in the user's account, depending on bank turnaround times and payment gateway processing cycles.
Please quote your transaction ID and registered phone number when contacting us for any refund or billing status inquiries.
